state_check.policy: predeclared; preserve descriptive values on state problems

pre_check.scope: fixed prepared input sequence; one repeated input cannot reveal arbitrary input/output permutations

observation.scope: One blocking DeepX producer invocation; no device queue occupancy claim

stage_contract.residency_note: Both prefix runtime/model and TensorRT engine/context/stream/pinned buffers loaded in every mode; inactive runtime receives no inference/warmup requests. H10 allocates 8 identically prefilled slots; DeepX uses one blocking producer.
stage_contract.sink_policy: FIFO3 bounded immediate owned-payload discard; P completion recorded after mapping/extraction before enqueue
stage_contract.consumer_replay_source_policy: four independent owned genuine handoff payloads preloaded; one pinned TRT input reused with full CPU staging/H2D per request
stage_contract.source_lifetime_limitation: C source ring is read repeatedly while PC receives freshly produced owned arrays; cache/residency may differ despite matched consumer work
stage_contract.consumer_policy: one execution context/stream; pinned staging plus H2D/TRT/D2H/sync plus ClassificationCompletion every request

post_check.scope: fixed prepared input sequence; one repeated input cannot reveal arbitrary input/output permutations

start_state.runner_affinity_limit: probe inherits SSH shell affinity; actual runner affinity is not independently observed here
start_state.throttling_scope: thermal/cooling state and visible clocks only; no device-specific throttle counter claim

end_state.runner_affinity_limit: probe inherits SSH shell affinity; actual runner affinity is not independently observed here
end_state.throttling_scope: thermal/cooling state and visible clocks only; no device-specific throttle counter claim
